Create ONE independent 16m community-maintained autonomous competition robot. Athletic and heroic, practical striking machine with visible maintenance modularity. No handheld weapons, wings, backpack cannons or shield.

Head signature: compact teal full helmet with continuous narrow amber sensor visor and smooth ivory closed faceplate. Chest signature: compact broad teal sternum shield with one stepped ivory bridge across its upper edge and an exposed ochre latch on the robot's left. A single narrow diagonal ochre brace runs from that latch into the side rib, leaving open dark rotary abdomen beneath. Broad clean planar design. Do not make a V chest with paired gold intake boxes, bird motif or a copied insignia.
Hands and forearms: strong compact martial-arts striking guards. Each hand has a thick ochre three-plate dorsal knuckle guard, ivory wrist cuff and readable dark segmented fingers. Powerful calves, broad articulated running boots, distinct ankle, no long front codpiece or hanging skirt. Palette: warm ivory dominant; rich deep teal secondary; ochre/gold concentrated at crown, knuckle guards and structural latches; charcoal joints; amber sensor is a small accent. Do not recolor toward orange/red. Preserve the individual machine's palette instead of recoloring the whole cast.

Style: polished anime mechanical design in the same current KINETIC_CEL drawing family as reference 2: confident variable-width dark ink, large readable paint planes, one or two crisp hard shadows, restrained secondary seams, mechanical volume without noisy photoreal PBR or soft airbrush. Do not draw a plastic toy render.
Composition: ONE robot only, front three-quarter full-body, grounded neutral athletic guard, both fists visible slightly forward, each foot fully present. Entire crown to soles within generous margin. Similar camera and relaxed stance to input 1 so the identity change is assessable. No extra close-up panels or duplicate limbs. Actual transparent background outside silhouette; no backdrop, floor, cast shadow, halo, text, emblems, numbers, labels or watermark.
